description: Details submitted pursuant to reference 25/02175/FUL: external finishing materials (3), SuDS (4), crossover (7), means of enclosure (8) and landscaping (9) in respect of sub-division of site and erection of a detached two storey dwellinghouse, new vehicular crossover, cycle and refuse storage.
decision_conditions: The details submitted are insufficient to satisfy the discharge of external finishing materials (3) and SuDS (4) of planning permission ref: 25/02175/FUL due to insufficient detailing regarding the proposed external materials including the proposed brickwork / render, and the lack of acceptable SuDs strategy to demonstrate how proposed measures manage the risk of flooding and utilise Sustainable Urban Drainage Systems (SuDS) following the drainage hierarchy in the London Plan. The proposal is therefore contrary to Section 9 and 14 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2021), Policies D4, SI 12 and  SI 13 of the London Plan (2021), CP30, CP21 and CP28 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD 8, DMD 37, DMD59, DMD60, DMD61 and DMD62 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014) and the Enfield Strategic Flood Risk Assessment (2021).
